lessons.title: Essential Daily Greetings
lessons.description: Common polite greetings and introductions used in everyday English conversations.

vocabulary_items.definition: Used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation.
vocabulary_items.example_sentence: Hello, it is nice to meet you.

vocabulary_items.definition: An instance or manner of greeting someone gladly.
The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation.
vocabulary_items.example_sentence: He expressed his sincere gratitude to the team.

lessons.title: Academic & Research Fundamentals
lessons.description: Foundational vocabulary for students and researchers in Computer Science.

vocabulary_items.definition: A process or set of rules to be followed in calculations or problem-solving operations.
vocabulary_items.example_sentence: The spaced repetition algorithm calculates optimal review intervals.

vocabulary_items.definition: The ability of an experiment or study to be duplicated by other researchers.
vocabulary_items.example_sentence: Deterministic data seeding is essential for scientific reproducibility.
